# CI dependency set. NOT a package manifest — this repository ships as a Levin
# plugin (.levin-plugin.tgz), not as a Python distribution.
#
# Zone 1 (below) mirrors mcp/runner/plugin_spec.py `PythonRuntime.packages`
# verbatim, in the same order. pip/uv cannot read pins out of a Python tuple, so
# the list is duplicated here; .github/scripts/check_requirements.py parses the
# tuple with ast and fails the build when the two drift apart.
jsonschema==4.23.0
filelock==3.16.1
reportlab==4.2.5
matplotlib==3.9.4
bibtexparser==2.1.0
# --- end of runtime pins ---
#
# Zone 2: what the *tests* need on top of the runtime pins.
#
# pypdf: tests/test_notebook.py imports it unconditionally (PDF page count plus
#   the tamper-detection assertion) and tests/test_reporting.py uses it in
#   reader(). It is NOT a runtime dependency of the plugin, so it is deliberately
#   absent from plugin_spec.py. Without it the run ends 155 tests + 1 error.
pypdf==7.0.0
#
# pillow: tests/test_reporting.py imports PIL directly to synthesize fixture
#   images. It also arrives transitively via matplotlib/reportlab, but a direct
#   import should not rely on another package's dependency graph.
pillow==11.0.0
